summary: The chapter's two closing rituals (the co-signing and the archive scene) are mostly concrete and load-bearing, but a named walk-on the scene isn't entitled to, a hallway hand-off that ignores Feuz's exit, a dialogue reduced to pure abstraction, and a paragraph that contradicts itself about how long Stettler stayed all need fixing before this passes.

issues.unit: P5: "Gemeindeschreiber Anton Hürlimann, der am Fenster saß"
issues.fix_hint: Cut the name and title; refer to him only as 'der Schreiber am Fenster' if a walk-on is needed at all, or cut the clause.

issues.unit: P8: "reichte Feuz ihm die Mappe noch einmal über den Schreibtisch"
issues.fix_hint: Move this second-signature beat before P7 (before Feuz puts on his coat and leaves), or cut it — as written, Feuz already left and cannot reach the desk from the hallway.
Replace the paragraph with what Berta and Stettler actually said to each other; delete the summary sentence.

issues.unit: P15: "Gleich nach Mittag hatte er das Amtszimmer verlassen"
issues.fix_hint: Cut this sentence — it directly contradicts 'Er blieb bis zum Abend im Amtszimmer' earlier in the same paragraph.
